run_dataset_statistics: run the script to calculate basic statistics over the TalkTheWalk training dataset
run_count_turkers: run the script to count the number of unique Turkers in the dataset
run_count_dialogue_turns: run the script to calculate average number of turns per dialogue
run_count_tourist_actions: run the script to count tourist actions and forward moves per dialogue
run_count_utterances: run the script to count average tourist and guide utterances per dialogue
